blockers.title: Primary rollout validation does not bind a rollout to the current candidate run
blockers.finding: The verifier reopens a real rollout and recomputes many fields, but the wrapper contains no candidate_id, run_id, call nonce, or independently exposed thread-create receipt. An actual historical candidate-v4 S10A_DECISION_A01 receipt and rollout with the byte-identical prompt passed independent_rollout_validation and was emitted as candidate-v6 PASS evidence. Candidate and run identity remain receipt assertions that can retag unrelated prior bytes.
blockers.impact: Historical or otherwise unrelated byte-compatible rollouts can be replayed as fresh candidate-v6 calls. Fresh task creation for this run and the 291/582-call denominator are not independently established even when thread and turn values are unique.
blockers.required_repair: Bind a unique candidate/run/cell dispatch nonce into the provider wrapper and primary rollout, or bind an independently captured create/turn invocation receipt that contains candidate_id and run_id; make completed_receipt and qualification reject any rollout whose primary bytes do not establish that binding.

blockers.title: Current tool activity can be omitted from prohibited evidence and score as clean
blockers.finding: Driver and verifier enumerate only function_call, function_call_output, web_search_call, computer_tool_call, and image_generation_call. Current stored rollout schemas also contain custom_tool_call, custom_tool_call_output, tool_search_call, and tool_search_output. In-memory injection of custom_tool_call or tool_search_call into an otherwise real strict JSONL rollout was accepted as PASS with prohibited_activity_item_count=0.
blockers.impact: A subject can use a currently represented tool path and still contribute PASS and clean qualification credit, violating the no-tools packet and the required prohibited-activity recomputation.
blockers.required_repair: Use a fail-closed response-item schema: explicitly classify every current tool-call and tool-output type as prohibited and reject unknown tool-capable/non-safe item types. Add real-schema adversarial holdouts for custom_tool_call and tool_search_call plus their outputs.

blockers.title: External freeze manifest derivation omits runtime and frozen snapshot dependencies
blockers.finding: validate_freeze_manifest derives runtime_dependencies only from architecture_contract.runtime_dependency_closure, which has 15 rows. r8_harness.FROZEN_BINDINGS has 28 rows; thirteen are absent from the architecture closure, including snapshot provenance, both source capsules, scorer/integration bytes, R5 harness, and seven R6 harnesses. Tension rendering also directly reopens eleven frozen fixture source files absent from manifest derivation.
blockers.impact: The prescribed external manifest can validate while bytes actually read or imported by preflight/render/score are outside its runtime inventory. Harness-local embedded hashes reject some drift at use time, but that is not the required complete external freeze and validate-freeze alone cannot attest the execution closure.
blockers.required_repair: Make architecture_contract.runtime_dependency_closure the complete set of every externally read/imported byte, including all 28 harness bindings and the eleven unique frozen source files, then require the external manifest to inventory the exact sorted closure and reject any missing, extra, duplicate, self, tampered, or drifted row.
